dedupe_keys.name: ieee pes distribution test feeders 4 bus to 8500 node and 9500 node reference distribution circuits

description: The IEEE PES distribution test feeders are the reference circuits of the Test Feeder Working Group of the IEEE Power & Energy Society, used to benchmark distribution analysis software. The home and resources pages read on 2026-09-26 trace the set from four radial feeders presented at the 1991 Winter Power Meeting and a transformer-connection feeder of 2001, through three cases introduced in 2010, a protection case with short-circuit solutions in 2011, a low-voltage urban-core network in 2014 and a European (UK) case in 2015, to the 9500 Node Test System, a full-size utility model with several feeders extending the 8500 node feeder for real-time testing of advanced applications. The resources page gives the original paper, line and cable data and zipped case files needing Word and Excel, with dated corrections, and describes the 13-bus (4.16 kV, short and heavily loaded), 34-bus (an actual 24.9 kV Arizona feeder) and 37-bus feeders among others; a 2017 IEEE Transactions paper summarises their design basis. Cases under development include quasi-static time series, a Chinese circuit, a large urban network and a microgrid. No licence is stated. Caveats: circuits are reduced models, and file formats are dated. Simulation uses are validating unbalanced power flow, protection and hosting capacity tools. Related records: data-iowa-distribution-test-systems gives real feeders with meter data.
